Step.name: # (comment)
Step.StepText: #Discharged children's folders are moved by hand to the Archive share (staff A: = server K:\Archive, same subfolders). If the child's folder is no longer on K: but is in Archive, file the note into the Archive folder instead of letting BE_FolderCreate rebuild a ghost folder on K:. Folder in neither place = new child, path unchanged. Folder in both = left on K:.

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.StepText: #Client folder = the path without the trailing Session Notes subfolder (Western/Eastern). Central paths are already the Client ID folder.
Step.Text: Client folder = the path without the trailing Session Notes subfolder (Western/Eastern). Central paths are already the Client ID folder.

Step.name: If
Step.StepText: If [ Left ( $clientFolder ; Length ( $liveRoot ) ) = $liveRoot and not BE_FileExists ( $clientFolder ) and BE_FileExists ( $archiveClientFolder ) ]
